title: Phase 8 PR-5: seven-field reversal history, and the transition that was never recorded
head: ee1850360bd23ebf4b116e0b8d40ccad58936579

codeant_findings.claim: CLI confirms and executes the batch with no ActionLogSink, so destructive CLI reversals leave no durable history.
codeant_findings.fix: --audit-log PATH added, required whenever --yes is passed (__main__.py:116, :167). MemoryStore(args.audit_log) constructed at :205 and passed as log= to both confirm (:213) and execute (:218).

codeant_findings.claim: confirm() recorded with backend=type(live.client).__name__, falsely attributing a local operator transition to the Tally backend.
codeant_findings.fix: backend parameter removed from reversal.confirm's signature entirely, not merely left unset. The web call site passes only log, company_key, run_id.

reanchoring_note: GitHub moved the app.py comment's commit_id forward from 6686752 to ee18503 and its line from 1720 to 1977 after the fix landed. A live-finding heuristic of commit_id==head AND line!=null therefore reports a false positive; both findings were verified against source rather than against comment metadata.
